items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro vs. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_1line: Kimi K3.1 Pro vs. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra R&D World
items.editor_note: Third-party head-to-head putting Kimi K3.1 Pro against Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.

editorial.tldr: Latent Space's Oct 7 newsletter put Claude Haiku 5.5 ahead of GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing. On Oct 20, Google Cloud added Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 to its Antigravity coding tool.
editorial.whats_new: R&D World compares Kimi K3.1 Pro against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra (Oct 23); only the headline is in the item, so the results are not confirmed here.
editorial.why_it_matters: Claude 5.5 models are reaching more surfaces (Antigravity), and a Chinese open-weight lab is now being benchmarked against Opus 5.5, so model-routing choices are being re-opened.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you route between models, rerun your own evals with Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1 Pro as candidates before changing defaults, and treat the Haiku 5.5 vs Luna claim as unverified until you test it.

status.detail: Claude 5.5 models are spreading to new platforms while Kimi K3.1 Pro is being compared against them; no outcome is confirmed in these items.
